youtube_description:
Congressman Beto O'Rourke, D-TX- El Paso is running for US Senator to represent the state of Texas as he has secured the March democratic primary nomination. 
Beto and his team have been traveling all over Texas with a goal to visit all 254 counties. 
I have asked him to graciously come to DeSoto, Texas which is in Dallas County, which is important because the highest voting location in Dallas County is in DeSoto Texas.
 DeSoto City Councilwoman Candice Quarles is driving Beto to a few spots in DeSoto including Top 5 BBQ. Then we arrive at The MINT Foundation for the Beto for DeSoto Townhall. 
Beto O-Rourke is running to unseat Ted Cruz who is currently the junior senator of Texas. 
To learn more about Beto and his campaign: Betofortexas.com 

This video was made with a Facebook Live from Beto O'Rourke's Facebook page. 

About my Channel:
Politics is my passion, so I became a politician. But it doesn’t have to be so lame so let’s put social media to use. I’m working on creating the next generation of voters. Join me. 
Subscribe to my Channel➜ https://www.youtube.com/c/candidwithcandice
This video was edited via Filmora Wondershare on my Lenovo Yoga ThinkPad. 
Ask me A Question on YouTube or Twitter @candicequarles
